answer.explanation: The live CompressionFunction config has Timeout=3 s and MemorySize=128 MB, but the IaC template (intended state) specifies Timeout=60 and MemorySize=1024. The function was modified at 21:11:30Z, two seconds before the window opened, and no commit in the window touches it. In the window, 415 of 1257 invocations (every one of the sampled REPORT lines) ended with Status: timeout at exactly 3000 ms, while peak memory use stayed around 94-97 MB, so the timeouts come from the reduced timeout rather than memory exhaustion. The other functions' live config matches the template, and the recent template commits only change TABLE_NAME or OUTPUT_BUCKET, which do not match this drift.
